message: is in the tag scan and not in the parsed tree
$reason: `widget-in-a-string` with a `<div>` a written role makes a widget, `ROLE="listbox"`, in place of the `<button>`. A tag the tree holds nothing for is read by the scan alone, and its role, which the scan took off a name written in lower case, made no widget: the string passed point 1, where `role="listbox"` fails it as a widget with no path. The scan reads a name as `nameOf` does now, in any case.
